ordinance.code_version: Municode Supp. 73 Upd. 1, codified through Ord. 2026-020 (2026-06-25)

district_conditions.PR1: dispensary max 5,000 sf gross floor area (Table 545-1 '5P', s.545.20(d))
district_conditions.PR2: micro/mezzo only: dispensary ACCESSORY to on-site cannabis cultivation or manufacturing, max 5,000 sf (s.545.450); must still meet 3-acre rule (2026 CPED interpretation)
district_conditions.CM2|CM3: micro/mezzo manufacturing: entrance opens into retail component >=15% of floor area; production <=5,000 sf (s.545.230)
district_conditions.CM4|DT1|DT2: micro/mezzo manufacturing: retail component >=30%; production <=5,000 sf (s.545.230)

buffers.measured_from: lot line of the cannabis lot
buffers.measured_to: lot line of the school lot
buffers.cite: s.545.210(f)(3)(a); measurement s.520.160(11) 'from lot line to lot line'

location_tests.rule: lot must lie within a contiguous commercial or industrial area >=3 acres made up of contiguous districts where a dispensary is a permitted principal use (CM2,CM3,CM4,DT1,DT2,PR1)
location_tests.UNVERIFIED: whether street right-of-way breaks contiguity; how PR2 acreage counts for accessory dispensaries

spacing_note: draft 500/300 ft spacing struck by Chowdhury amendment; none in adopted s.545.210
cap_note: Ch.355 registration has no numeric limit; draft deck 'No license caps'
registrations_issued: UNVERIFIED (no public list); 24 OCM-licensed retailers in Minneapolis per bricks mn_retailers.json
other_rules: principal use only unless accessory to cultivation/manufacturing (s.545.210(f)(3)(c))
no common entrance with any non-cannabis use (s.545.210(f)(3)(d))
odor control and air filtration plan (s.545.210(f)(3)(e))
no portable, temporary, backlit or freestanding signs for cannabis businesses (Ch.560)
registration with city licensing official before retail sales (Ch.355)
notes: daycare, treatment and park buffers allowed by Minn. Stat. 342.13(c) were NOT adopted
city map caveat: 'Applicants should not rely on this map alone for land use verification.'
